cohort: The study included 44 pregnant women with Intrahepatic Cholestasis of Pregnancy (ICP) and 44 pregnant women without ICP as controls.
finding: Women with Intrahepatic Cholestasis of Pregnancy (ICP) exhibited significantly lower mean levels of Vitamin K1 and Vitamin K2 MK7, and experienced higher mean blood loss during vaginal delivery compared to controls.
mod_finding: Mean blood loss during vaginal delivery was significantly higher in women with ICP compared to controls.
followup_time: until delivery and immediate postpartum period
